project.name: Callsmith
project.summary: The browser-native WebMCP safety workbench that compares weak and hardened website contracts and catches unsafe state transitions expected-call checks miss.
project.ai_usage: OpenAI Responses agents run through webmcp-evals browser mode against isolated weak and hardened WebMCP contracts; preview and server-simulation paths are not part of the product.
project.codex_usage: Product shaping, parallel implementation, integration debugging, browser verification, Railway deployment, and judge-ready documentation.
